author: Cobratate
text:
The problem with FDC Miami is an extension of the rot of modern culture as a whole.

You are rewarded here for doing the wrong thing.

Flood your cell? Fight a guard? Stab someone? Scream and yell? They will move you where you need to go, give you what you want, anything to shut you up.

If you follow the rules, show respect and behave you are treated the worst.

Ignored while they focus on the trouble makers.

This is the exact problem with modern society at large.

Follow the rules, do the right thing, pay your taxes - and you are endlessly crushed by regulators and authorities.

But if you’re homeless and repeatedly steal with no concern for the laws you are released on repeat and babied at the rule followers' expense.

GOOD behavior should be rewarded. Not trouble-making.

Why demand I flood my cell and light fires to give me my basic rights?
Why demand the worst of me?
Why not respect me for sitting in the SHU unit for 61 days in lotus position focusing on my breathing instead of losing my mind?

If any competent authority investigated this prison it would be closed the same day.

I have provided an evidence pack to my council Joseph McBride.

I would never kill myself.
